commit.subject: LU-16489 tests: lustre-rsync-test/2c sync last unlinks
commit.message:
LU-16489 tests: lustre-rsync-test/2c sync last unlinks

Ensure that lustre_rsync is run one final time after dbench
exits and the dbench binaries/libraries are deleted from the
test directory.  Otherwise it is possible that the final file
deletion is not sync'd and the test will report an error:

    Changelog records consumed: 0
    Only in ./target/d2c.lustre-rsync-test: clients
    Only in ./target/d2c.lustre-rsync-test: client.txt
    Only in ./target/d2c.lustre-rsync-test: dbench
    Only in ./target/d2c.lustre-rsync-test/lib64: ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
    Only in ./target/d2c.lustre-rsync-test/lib64: libc.so.6
    Only in ./target/d2c.lustre-rsync-test/lib64: libpopt.so.0

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Andreas Dilger <adilger@thelustrecollective.com>
